newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fair Cargo appointed Air Transat's Paris cargo GSA.
newsitem.headline: Fair Cargo appointed Air Transat's Paris cargo GSA.

text.p: Paris/CDG-based Fair Cargo, said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent for Canadian airline, Air Transat, effective May 1 and was poised to sign agreements with other airlines in the near future.

"Air Transat's passenger charter services between France and Canada do not include traffic rights for freight so for the coming months at least our activities will be limited to developing off-line capacity via a trucking link with Amsterdam/Schiphol.
From October 1 1997 Air Transat will begin operating scheduled services from France carrying both passengers and freight," a Fair Cargo official told Reuters.
Montreal-based Air Transat operates charter services between France-Canada using a fleet of Boeing 757 and Lockheed Tristar aircraft.

Flights link Paris and provincial cities such as Nantes, Bordeaux, Toulouse, Marseille, Nice and Lyon with several destinations in Canada including Montreal, Quebec City, Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver with up to two flights per day during the tourist season, a Paris-based Air Transat spokesman said.

Air Transat had yet to finalise its programme of scheduled services between France and Canada but departures from Paris, Lyon and Nice were under consideration, the airline spokesman added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
